translated: [CORNER: Song] And now, it's time to play a song.
This song features Shizuku as the lead. I hope you'll listen along and feel the changing weather of her heart as the song progresses.
[CORNER: Theme Mail] For this episode, we asked for mail on this theme:
"What you're looking forward to this autumn."
The late summer heat is still lingering, but autumn will be here before we know it.
So, we asked everyone to send in what they're looking forward to this fall.
Let's get right into the mail.
This one is from Radio name: Agetate no Potato.
"What I'm looking forward to this autumn is the maple leaves."
"I'm going to Kyoto in September to see the foliage."
"I usually go to Kyoto in the summer, so this will be my first time going in the fall."
"I've seen photos of the leaves at places like Kiyomizu-dera and thought they were beautiful,"
"so I'm really excited to go see them for myself."
I have, I have, I have.
